# --instructions--

Write a function `unique(items)` that returns a new array with the values of `items` without duplicates, keeping the order of their first appearance

```javascript
  catch (e) {

  }
```

# --seed--

```javascript
function unique(items) {

}
```

# --asserts--

`unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1])` must return `[3, 1, 2]`.

```javascript
tryCatch(JSON.stringify(unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1])) === '[3,1,2]');
```

`unique(["a", "b", "a"])` must return `["a", "b"]`.

```javascript
tryCatch(JSON.stringify(unique(["a", "b", "a"])) === '["a","b"]');
```

`unique([])` must return `[]`.

```javascript
tryCatch(JSON.stringify(unique([])) === '[]');
```

The result must be an array, not a set.

```javascript
tryCatch(Array.isArray(unique([1, 1])) === true);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function unique(items) {
  return [...new Set(items)];
}
```
